title: Live-review close on tradeify_1 reported APPLIED + verified_readback true, but the position is still open at Tradeify
note: MEASURED 2026-11-15. LR-20261115T1141Z-pkg-ec406687dc6d449f (SOL ml_entry close) receipt at 11:43:36Z: tradeify_1 [prop_vm] APPLIED, approve_action:close within_bounds, executor applied, disposition verified_readback true; ticket prop-manual-92b2c4bc26e5 op_status closed / close_reason live_review_close. Defect: the prop close path marks the ticket closed and reports a verified readback without the venue position going flat, so the receipt claims a close that did not happen (a real-money/prop silent-failure class). Owner AM-OPS: (1) executor journal for what happened to the close; (2) re-apply route options to the manager, no order by hand; (3) fix so the readback reads the venue terminal position, not the ticket state. Done when a prop close is reported applied only after the terminal shows the position flat, with a test. 2026-11-15 AM-OPS root cause: the prop executor refused the close modal because its heading reads 'Close SOL/USD Buy Position' and _close_modal_mismatch expected the bare 'SOLUSD'; it pressed Discard every tick from 11:44:09Z. vm_close vmc-a2ad1dce4531 is result=retrying (12 attempts by 12:48:40Z). The modal fix is #26302 (row PROP-CLOSE-MODAL-SLASH). The receipt fix: 'applied/verified' may be reported only once the venue_terminal reads flat for that symbol; a queued or retrying vm_close is not applied. Re-entry test: a refused prop close yields a receipt that is NOT applied/verified. 13:34Z manager 15a: #26302 (modal slash fix) deployed 13:24Z, but the SOL close is now blocked by a SECOND cause: since 13:18-13:21Z the tradeify terminal's active workspace is 'Trading Dashboard', not 'My Trading Account' (likely the firm reloaded into a default tab after a 45 s page-load timeout at 13:18:00Z). Executor ticks fail with 'no positions table found'; the watchlist canary reads MISSING; add-watchlist-widget (#26323) refused. Fix in flight: #26327 (select-workspace mode, Tier 2, RESTART), or the operator clicks the 'My Trading Account' tab once. Row PROP-TRADEIFY-WORKSPACE-SWITCHED. SL/TP still rest at the firm on both legs. 2026-11-15 15:18Z: the eventual SOL close fill (closed_on_terminal reconcile) was booked with reason='manual', although it was the live-review vm_close vmc-a2ad1dce4531. The close attribution should name the review close request, not 'manual' (same fix family: the receipt and the fill must reflect the real path). 2026-11-16 00:25Z AM-OPS-2 MEASURED: SOL review LR-20261116T0012Z-pkg-09c923d9af344d2a close on the prop books: tradeify_1 prop-manual-4e3943e1588d (vmc-6a633ff5a711) and velotrade_1 prop-manual-1a50ac6d076e (vmc-e2571949c2bd) are both status=placed (never filled; venue_terminal positions had no SOL), now op_status=closed / close_reason=live_review_close. ETH short on velotrade_1 (fill 293) still open on the terminal, so the close touched SOL only. Receipt text not read; whether the unfilled SOL limit order was cancelled at the venue is UNVERIFIED. Same class as the false-applied receipt (a close reported for a ticket with no position). Separate: ETH SL lag = PROP-STRUCTURE-SL-LAG, HOLD PR #26422. 2026-11-16 00:30Z AM-OPS-2 MEASURED (executor journal, ict-prop-executor@<acct>): the SOL limit entries WERE placed and still rest. tradeify_1 Sell 28.9 SOL @72.72 submitted 00:14:10Z (orders=2 at 00:23Z: SOL + the ETH entry); velotrade_1 SOL placed 00:08:15Z (orders=5 at 00:23Z: ETH SL/TP + SOL entry/bracket). Fix needed: a close request on a placed-only ticket must cancel the working entry (vm_close), and the ticket/receipt must not read closed until the venue shows no order. Expiry cancel at valid_until 01:03Z is the only automatic cancel. 2026-11-16 00:31Z manager decision: wait for the 01:03Z expiry of the two resting SOL entries (bracketed SL 74.45, ~21-25 USD risk each); no cancel-path build tonight. REAL FIX FILED (deferred to after the 2026-11-18 18:00Z reset unless it recurs): vm_close must cancel a working (unfilled) entry, or the ticket must not read op_status=closed while the order rests.
